fee.schedule_and_authority.summary: A public body that establishes fees must post a written schedule of the fees at its principal office and with the county clerk.
Where the cost of copying/reproducing/certifying each individual record is otherwise prescribed by state law, the body may assess that cost per individual record or portion requested.

payment.advance_payment.summary: A public body may require advance payment of estimated fees when the estimated cost exceeds $75.00 or if the requestor has outstanding fees from previous requests; any portion of an advance payment exceeding the actual cost of responding must be returned to the requestor.
